oocyte: An oocyte is a female gametocyte that develops into an ovum after two meiotic divisions.
oodles: An oodles is a large number or amount.
For example: "Made lots of new friends."
Oodles means the same as tons or dozens or heaps.
oology: An oology is the branch of zoology that studies eggs.
oolong: Oolong is Chinese tea leaves that have been partially fermented before being dried.
oom paul kruger: Oom Paul Kruger is Boer statesman.
Oom Paul Kruger means the same as Kruger or Stephanus Johannes Paulus Kruger.
oomph: Oomph is attractiveness to the opposite sex.
Oomph can also mean the activeness of an energetic personality.
Oomph means the same as sex appeal or desirability or desirableness.
oomycetes: Oomycetes is nonphotosynthetic fungi that resemble algae and that reproduce by forming oospores.
Oomycetes means the same as class Oomycetes.
oophorectomy: Oophorectomy is surgical removal of one of both ovaries.
Oophorectomy means the same as ovariectomy.
oophoritis: Oophoritis is inflammation of one or both ovaries.
oophorosalpingectomy: Oophorosalpingectomy is surgical removal of one or both ovaries and the corresponding Fallopian tubes.
oort: Oort is Dutch astronomer who proved that the galaxy is rotating and proposed the existence of the Oort cloud.
Oort means the same as Jan Hendrix Oort.
oort cloud: Oort cloud is a hypothetical huge collection of comets orbiting the sun far beyond the orbit of Pluto.
oospore: An oospore is a thick-walled sexual spore that develops from a fertilized oosphere in some algae and fungi.
ootid: Ootid is mature ovum after penetration by sperm but before the formation of a zygote.
ooze: An ooze is any thick, viscous matter.
Ooze can also mean pass gradually or leak through or as if through small openings.
Ooze can also mean the process of seeping.
Ooze means the same as sludge or slime or goo.
ooze leather: An ooze leather is a very soft leather made from the skins of calves and having a suede finish on the flesh side.
oozing: Oozing can also mean the process of seeping.
Oozing means the same as oozy or seeping or seepage.
ooh: To ooh means to express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'.
For example: "They oohed and aahed when they unwrapped the presents."
Ooh means the same as aah.
ooze out: To ooze out means to release in drops or small quantities.
For example: "Exude sweat through the pores."
Ooze out means the same as exude or exudate or transude.
ooze through: To ooze through means to run slowly and gradually.
For example: "Blood oozed through the bandage."
oozy: Oozy means the same as oozing or seeping.
